statement: Let F/κ be a function field over an algebraically closed field of characteristic different from ℓ. Suppose that a valuation v of F, with Fv/κv a function field, has the following properties: (i) vF has no nonzero ℓ-divisible convex subgroup; (ii) there is a subfield κ ⊂ κ1 ⊂ F such that κ1v = κv, trdeg(F/κ1) = trdeg(Fv/κ1v) = 1. Then b Jv contains the full minimized inertia group b Iu of every c.r. quasi-prime divisor u of Fv/κv.
